entries.german:
Nikolaus von Passauerschlag schenkt der Kirche St. Jakob zu Kirchschlag und ihrem Pfarrer den Zehent von seinem Dorf zu Dworzatschlag (Uretschlag).

"Ego, Nicolaus de Passawerslag(1), profiteor in hijs scriptis, quod deliberacione prehabita de bona voluntate vxoris mee et omnium puerorum meorum donaui ecclesie sancti Jacobi in Circhslac(2) et plebano ibidem plenas decimas in curia mea in Dworsacslag(3) libere et solute perpetue possidendas, talibus condicionibus interpositis et adiectis, quod si me uel heredes sev successores meos uendere seu obligare uel quocunque alio modo locare contigerit, semper tamen, ut predictum est, plebanus prefate ecclesie plenas decimas in agris dicte curie colliget et tenebit. Adicio eciam, quod si temporibus meis uel heredum meorum agri dicte curie mee fuerint aucmentatj, quocunque modo de hijs sicut de prioribus plene decime persoluentur. Et ne talis donacio mea per me uel aliquem heredum sev successorum meorum irritetur, presentes litteras donaui, mej et awunculi mei domini Wazlai(4), purcrauij de Rosenberch, sigillorum munimine roboratas. Huius rei testes sunt: dominus Budilaus de Laucav(5), Chwalo(6) et Pribislaus(7) fratres de Shestav(8), Nicolaus(9) et Busco(10) fratres de Chirchslac, Stephanus(11) judex ibidem, Ludwicus de Drasen(12), et alij quam plures. Datum anno Domini Mo. CCCo XII. jn conuersione sancti Pauli apostoli jn Passawerslac."

Siegel: Siegel an Pergamentbändchen hängend: 1) Nikolaus von Passauerschlag. Braunes Wachs, rund, 35 mm Dm. Umschrift: "+ NICOLAI DE PASAV[ERSLAG]" (ergänzt aus Urk 100, S 82). Wappen: Dreiecksschild, darin schräge Fläche, dahinter ein Mensch mit Spiegel (?) 2) Wenzeslaus, Burggraf der Rosenberger. Braunes Wachs, rund, 28 mm Dm. Umschrift: "... WENEZLAI ... RCRAVII ROSEN[BERG]" Wappen: Runder Schild, darin Helm in Strahlenkranz.
entries.english:
Nikolaus von Passauerschlag gives the church of Saint James at Kirchschlag and its parish priest the full tithe from his village at Dworzatschlag. The gift is made with the prior consent of his wife and all his children, to be held freely and perpetually. If he, his heirs, or his successors should sell, pledge, or otherwise transfer the property, the priest shall nevertheless continue to collect and hold the full tithe from the fields of that farm. If the fields are enlarged during his or his heirs' time, full tithes shall likewise be paid from the additions. To prevent this gift from being annulled by him or any of his heirs or successors, he has issued this charter, sealed with his own seal and that of his uncle Wenceslaus von Rosenberg, Burggraf. Witnesses include Lord Budilaus von Laucav; Chwalo and Pribislaus, brothers von Shestav; Nikolaus and Busco, brothers from Kirchschlag; Stephanus, judge there; Ludwicus von Drasen; and many others. Given in Passauerschlag in 1312, on the Feast of the Conversion of Saint Paul.

Seals: Two seals hanging from parchment strips: Nikolaus von Passauerschlag's, in brown wax, round, 35 mm in diameter, bearing a triangular shield with a diagonal field and a figure holding a mirror (?) behind it; and Wenceslaus von Rosenberg's, Burggraf, in brown wax, round, 28 mm in diameter, bearing a round shield with a helmet in a radiate halo.
